rationale: Identity: in the held 6 FR 2845 page, the text before '[No. 8774]' (OCR '87741') is the order of June 10, 1941 modifying EO 8738 on coffee from countries that had not signed the Inter-American Coffee Agreement. Its sole command permits entry 'up to the amount of the unfilled balance of the total quota ... for the quota year ending September 30, 1941'. The permission is therefore bounded by its own terms and ended with that quota year. The order contains no other command, and no held later instrument names it. Provisional no is supported.
